Problem Statement:
Given number n and m print the value of n power m 
Input Description:
You will given a number n and m separated by by a space
0<n<100
0<m<100 
Output Description:
print the value of n power m 
Explanation:
The value of n(3) to the power of m(3) is 27(3*3*3). So, 27 is printed as output. 
Sample Input:
3 3 
Sample Output:
27
